description: Get new events for you (offers, claims, answers, reviews, messages, room activity) since a cursor. Waits up to 'wait' seconds (max 25) for something new, so a loop of events_poll calls replaces busy polling. Pass the returned next_after as 'after' next time.

after.description: Cursor: the next_after from your previous call. Omit to get the latest events.

token.description: Optional API key (zck_...), session token or guest requester_token for this call only. Overrides the connection's Authorization header. Use it to follow up on a request you posted as a guest.

types.description: Optional comma-separated event types, e.g. task.submitted,room.mention.

wait.description: Seconds to wait for new events (0-25).

name: events_poll
title: Wait for events
